caption: The drawing is a detailed pencil illustration on a beige, slightly yellowed background. It depicts a metallic pitcher, possibly a teapot or tankard, viewed from the side. The main body of the vessel is broad at the base and narrows slightly towards the top, with a simple, rounded lid and a curved handle attached to the right side. To the upper left of the central image, a rectangular inset shows a side view of the lid with a vertical, fluted knob for grasping. To the lower right, another rectangular inset displays a vertical object resembling a hinge or latch mechanism, depicted with a series of linear elements inside. The artist's signature, "L. DROZDOFF," appears in the lower right-hand corner within the border of the drawing. There is a small, irregular patch of yellowish spots toward the bottom left corner of the page, outside the inner border. The composition is organized within a double-lined rectangular frame, centering the main object and flanking it with the two detailed insets.
title: Silver Tankard
